clauses.text: The driver must actually reach the pickup point (GPS within 100 m of the pickup and stopped) for waiting time to count.
Free waiting time is 5 minutes, counted from the driver's arrival.
The driver must make at least 1 contact attempt (call or message); otherwise the cancellation fee is void.
If any condition above is not met, the cancellation fee is refunded in full; if all are met, the fee stands and is not refunded.

refund_formula: if driver_arrived(proximity<gps_arrival_proximity_m AND dwell>=free_wait_time_min) AND contact_attempts>=min_contact_attempts: refund=0 (fee valid) else refund=no_show_fee (full refund)
